narrative: Right now you are running the Venus Mahadasha, which sits in the 1st house of your chart — meaning this period is touching that part of your life more, and it is affecting Career accordingly. Within that, the Jupiter Antardasha is also running, which is in your 8th house, and it is currently retrograde too — its effect will be felt a little later, but more deeply. You are also currently in the "peak" phase of Sade Sati — you may feel effort is higher and results come a bit slower, but this is a phase to pass through with patience and consistency, nothing to worry about. The good news is that there is no Kaal Sarp Yoga in your chart, so don't worry about this obstacle when making big decisions. Mangal Dosha is also present — a little extra understanding and communication will help in matters of relationships and partnership. Advice: don't rush into major financial or career decisions — this period will benefit you when you work with consistency, so don't look for shortcuts.

remedies.title: Mangal Dosha
remedies.text: Giving charity of masoor lentils or red items on Tuesday, and — when angry — saying "A’oodhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem" and performing wudu (a Sunnah taught by the Prophet ﷺ) is considered beneficial.

remedies.title: Sade Sati — peak phase
remedies.text: Giving charity of black sesame or mustard oil on Saturday, helping the poor and laborers, and focusing more on seeking forgiveness, patience and regular prayer is considered beneficial.

remedies.title: Note
remedies.text: These are general suggestions based on classical/traditional principles — don't take them as a firm guarantee; for important decisions (especially about marriage or health), do consult a trusted scholar or expert.

yogas.title: Budhaditya Yoga
yogas.description: The Sun and Mercury are together in the same sign — this forms Budhaditya Yoga, considered a sign of intelligence and strong communication ability.
yogas.cause: The Sun and Mercury are in the same sign.

yogas.title: Dhana Yoga
yogas.description: The lord of the 2nd house (wealth), Mars, and the lord of the 11th house (income), Saturn, are together in the same sign — this forms Dhana Yoga, considered a sign of financial prosperity.
yogas.cause: The lords of the 2nd and 11th houses are in the same sign.

yogas.title: Malavya Yoga
yogas.description: Venus is in a Kendra house in its exalted sign — this forms "Malavya Yoga", one of the Panch Mahapurusha Yogas, considered a sign of a strong personality, leadership ability and success.
yogas.cause: Venus is in its exalted sign, in Kendra house 1.

yogas.title: Raja Yoga
yogas.description: The lord of the 4th house (Mercury) and the lord of the 9th house (Mars) are together in the same sign — this forms a Kendra-Trikona Raja Yoga, considered a sign of honor, power and elevation.
yogas.cause: The lord of the 4th house and the lord of the 9th house are in the same sign.

yogas.title: Harsha Yoga (Vipreet Raja)
yogas.description: The lord of the 6th house (Sun) sits in another difficult house (12) — this forms "Harsha Yoga (Vipreet Raja)", considered a sign of unexpected progress despite difficulties.
yogas.cause: The lord of the 6th house is in the 12th house.
